_note: APRS natural-hazard categories for the dashboard hazard pills and the map. A station matches a hazard ONLY when its (sym_table, sym_code) is listed in `symbols` — the APRS symbol is the trigger. A comment can never create a match (too many false positives: a motorcycle whose comment says 'like a tornado', a digipeater named 'Lake Smoke'). `name_exclude` is an optional list of case-insensitive whole-word keywords that VETO a symbol match (e.g. an obvious test/joke station squatting the emergency symbol); it can only remove a match, never add one. sym_table is '/' (primary) or '\' (alternate). Symbol codes verified against the shipped APRS-Symbols.pdf: '\t'=Tornado, '\w'=Flooding, '\E'=Smoke, '\@'=Hurricane/Tropical Storm, '\!'=Emergency, '/:'=Fire. Edit freely to add regional hazards (e.g. '\y'=Skywarn) — read locally, no network. Icons are NOT stored here: each hazard's glyph comes from its `key` via common/js/hazard-icons.js (unknown keys get a warning triangle), because Raspberry Pi OS ships no emoji font and the emoji this file used to carry drew tofu boxes on the kiosk.
